items.label: Farms in the demo district
items.explanation: Synthetic district in Cap Bon, Tunisia.

items.label: Feeder capacity
items.explanation: Rating of the rural feeder that serves all 200 farms.

items.label: Days of simulated history
items.explanation: 2024-11-01 to 2026-10-31, hourly weather from Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0).

items.label: Forecaster test period
items.explanation: Days 2026-06-01 .. 2026-10-31, held out from training; acceptance rules fixed before evaluation.

items.label: Backtest days
items.explanation: The test-period days with the highest unmanaged feeder load (the hardest summer days).

items.label: Main adoption level
items.explanation: Share of farms with a Tameru relay box in the main scenario.

items.label: Worst feeder peak without Tameru
items.explanation: Highest 15-min feeder load over the backtest days, every farm pumping at its usual time.

items.label: Mean daily peak without Tameru
items.explanation: Mean of the daily peaks over the 20 worst days.

items.label: Time over capacity without Tameru
items.explanation: Total time the feeder is above 1,000 kW over 20 days (load-shedding risk).

items.label: Energy above capacity without Tameru
items.explanation: Energy above the feeder rating over 20 days.

items.label: Mean daily peak with Tameru, closed loop (live mode)
items.explanation: 50% adoption, 20 worst days, replayed with actual load and actual farmer behaviour.

items.label: Worst daily peak with Tameru, closed loop (live mode)
items.explanation: 50% adoption: the highest daily peak of the 20 days (compare with unmanaged_worst_peak).

items.label: Time over capacity with Tameru, closed loop (live mode)
items.explanation: Total over 20 days at 50% adoption.

items.label: Energy above capacity with Tameru, closed loop (live mode)
items.explanation: Total over 20 days at 50% adoption.

items.label: Mean peak cut, closed loop (live mode)
items.explanation: Mean reduction of the daily peak vs no Tameru, 50% adoption.

items.label: Days still over capacity, closed loop (live mode)
items.explanation: Out of 20 days, at 50% adoption.

items.label: Mean daily peak with Tameru, open loop (one plan at midnight)
items.explanation: 50% adoption, 20 worst days, replayed with actual load and actual farmer behaviour.

items.label: Worst daily peak with Tameru, open loop (one plan at midnight)
items.explanation: 50% adoption: the highest daily peak of the 20 days (compare with unmanaged_worst_peak).

items.label: Time over capacity with Tameru, open loop (one plan at midnight)
items.explanation: Total over 20 days at 50% adoption.

items.label: Energy above capacity with Tameru, open loop (one plan at midnight)
items.explanation: Total over 20 days at 50% adoption.

items.label: Mean peak cut, open loop (one plan at midnight)
items.explanation: Mean reduction of the daily peak vs no Tameru, 50% adoption.

items.label: Days still over capacity, open loop (one plan at midnight)
items.explanation: Out of 20 days, at 50% adoption.

items.label: Reduction of time over capacity (closed loop)
items.explanation: 75.2 h -> 4.5 h at 50% adoption.

items.label: Mean daily peak with a perfect forecast
items.explanation: Open loop where the planner is given the actual base load. Close to the real-forecast result, so forecast error costs little; the hourly re-plan (closed loop) does better still.

items.label: Minimum adoption for zero overload
items.explanation: Smallest share of farms with Tameru for which none of the 20 worst days goes over capacity (open loop, every higher level also overload-free).

items.label: Mean daily peak at 70% adoption
items.explanation: Open loop, 20 worst days.

items.label: Mean daily peak at 100% adoption
items.explanation: Open loop, 20 worst days.

items.label: Planning time per re-plan (live mode)
items.explanation: lp_round planner for the whole district from midnight; the closed loop re-plans every hour.

items.label: Planning time, exact MILP reference
items.explanation: Binary on/off optimisation with HiGHS; used as the reference, too slow to re-plan often.

items.label: Fewer pump commands into full tanks
items.explanation: Planner fix: minutes where a pump was told to run but the float switch stopped it, before vs after.

items.label: Forecast error (MAE)
items.explanation: Day-ahead p50 forecast of the non-pump load, 15-min steps, issued at midnight, test period.

items.label: Forecast error (MAPE)
items.explanation: Mean absolute percentage error, test.

items.label: Forecast error 17-20 h (MAPE)
items.explanation: Error during the evening peak hours, test period.

items.label: Error of 'same as yesterday'
items.explanation: Simple baseline: tomorrow = today.

items.label: Error of 'same day last week'
items.explanation: Simple baseline: tomorrow = same weekday last week.

items.label: Better than 'same as yesterday'
items.explanation: 1 - model error / baseline error.

items.label: Better than 'same day last week'
items.explanation: 1 - model error / baseline error.

items.label: Daily peak error
items.explanation: Gap between forecast and actual daily maximum, test period.

items.label: p90 band coverage
items.explanation: Share of actual values below the p90 forecast (target 90 %), test period, after calibration.

items.label: p90 coverage 18-19 h before calibration
items.explanation: Raw model, test period.

items.label: p90 coverage 18-19 h after calibration
items.explanation: Per-hour conformal offsets learned on cross-validation folds (not on the test period).

items.label: Model in use, cross-validation error
items.explanation: Out-of-fold error on rolling-origin folds inside the training period (comparison with the v2 experiment).

items.label: v2 experiment, cross-validation error
items.explanation: Richer heat features; v1 had 20.91 kW. Not clearly better under the rule fixed in advance, so the simpler calibrated v1 was kept.

items.label: Error cut by intraday correction at 17:00
items.explanation: Rest-of-day forecast rescaled with the last hour of measurements.

items.label: Effect of a +10 % planning margin at 70 % adoption
items.explanation: Change of mean peak; the p90 forecast already acts as the safety margin, so none is added.

items.label: Water saved with the budget enforced (50 %)
items.explanation: Conservative: water asked for above the crop need that was not supplied; mean over the 20 test days.

items.label: Water saved, upper bound (50 %)
items.explanation: Pumping cut vs budget off; includes tank drawdown, so the true saving lies between the two values.

items.label: Pumping vs no Tameru, budget off (50 %)
items.explanation: Reserve top-ups and end-of-day refill.

items.label: Pumping vs no Tameru, budget enforced (50 %)
items.explanation: Daily pumping capped at 110 % of the FAO-56 crop need, never below the need.

items.label: Unmet crop need, budget enforced (50 %)
items.explanation: Crop need asked for and not delivered.

items.label: Energy saved by the budget (50 %)
items.explanation: Energy of the water not pumped (curtailed excess x each pump's kWh/m³).

items.label: CO₂ avoided by the budget (50 %)
items.explanation: Energy saved x grid factor. Moving pumping in time is not counted.
items.factor_source: IFI Dataset of Default Grid Factors v2.0 (2019 dataset), 404 gCO2/kWh

items.label: Pump CO₂ footprint, budget enforced (50 %)
items.explanation: Pump energy x grid factor.
items.factor_source: IFI Dataset of Default Grid Factors v2.0 (2019 dataset), 404 gCO2/kWh

items.label: Farm-days pumping above the budget, enforced (50 %)

items.label: Median bill saving per adopting farm, STEG BT three-period, budget off
items.explanation: Closed loop 50 % vs no Tameru, tax included, median per farm over the 20 test days (modest); p10 -0.58, p90 61.8; 12 of 94 adopting farms see their bill go up.
